name: Drifter's Focus
description: Your regain half of your FP when you perform 1 or more Manuevers, provided you don't spend FP as part of that Action

name: Fighting Style
description: Choose 1 Weapon Style. Add +1 to any Attack you make using a weapon with your chosen Weapon Style. Alternatively, choose between Light Armor, Heavy Armor, Light Shield, Medium Shield, or Light Shield. When you are using that type of equipment, add +1 to your AC.

name: Second Wind
description: Once per Long Rest, you can spend 1 AP to regain a number of HP equal to your Combat Proficiency.

name: Know your Enemy
description: You can spend 1 minute observing or interacting with a creature out of Combat (or spend 1 AP in Combat) to learn information about its physical capabilities compared to your own. Choose one of the following stats of the creature to assess: Brawn, Reflex, AC, DRd, and HP. Make a DC 10 Investigation or Insight Check (your choice). On a success, you learn if the chosen stat is higher, lower, or the same as yours.
